resources.string: Get a notification when Hermes finishes a reply, needs your approval or an answer, or a turn fails, even while the app is closed. Notifications are end-to-end encrypted: the push relay and Google only see that something arrived.
Every profile and bot on this Hermes notifies this phone. Leave one out below.
Notifies another phone. Hermes notifies one phone per profile.
Android limits this app in the background

A few seconds after you leave the app, Android cuts its network. A message or a reply still on its way is finished in the background for up to three minutes, and replies come as notifications. To keep it connected longer, allow the app unrestricted battery use in its settings.
On this phone, also turn on Autostart there, or notifications may stop once the app is closed.
The relay that hands notifications to Google. It sees only sealed messages.
Notifications are turned off for this app. Allow them in Android\'s settings, then try again.
Sound and pop-ups for each kind
This build of the app has no push settings, so it can\'t receive notifications.
This Hermes doesn\'t have the talaria_push plugin. Install it on the Hermes host (hermes plugins install dawnforge-lab/talaria-plugin --enable), then try again.
Enter the push relay\'s https:// address.
Google Play services didn\'t give this phone a push token. Check that Play services is installed and up to date, and that you\'re online.
The relay\'s check of this phone didn\'t arrive. Check your connection and try again.
The push relay can\'t be reached. Check its address and your connection.
This push relay can\'t send to Android phones.
This push relay doesn\'t accept this app.
Google refused this phone\'s push token. Try again in a moment.
The push relay asked to slow down. Try again in a minute.
A reply to a message sent from a source turned off here sends no reply notification. This applies to every profile on this phone.

Run these on the Hermes host for this profile: first check its pairing, then send a test. It should arrive here within a few seconds. Tap one to copy it.
